title: INAH — El agua y la arquitectura: San Bernardino de Siena, Valladolid

facts.fact: The convent in Valladolid’s Sisal district is sixteenth-century Franciscan heritage. The article documents architecture, not current admission.
facts.excerpt: testimonio de la arquitectura franciscana del siglo XVI

facts.fact: The Síis Já cenote lies beneath the convent and is an archaeological research context, not the public urban Zací or a promised bathing visit.
facts.excerpt: Bajo el antiguo convento se localiza el cenote Síis Já

readingScope: Relevant article body and fact excerpts actually read; page capture alone is not treated as editorial verification.
